body.p: The Add/Edit Configuration dialog box defines how translations are performed when using an Oxygen AI Positron connector and AI models. You can configure retry models, quality checks, and related behavior.

ul.li: Configuration name - Enter a custom name for this configuration (e.g. "Fast Config").
Translation model - Select the primary AI model to use for translation (e.g. "GPT-4.1 Nano").

Enable quality checks & retries - When selected, the system runs additional checks to verify translation quality. If a check fails, the translation is marked as needing review (the state attribute is set to needs-review-l10n), and the system can retry the translation using alternative models. This may increase costs because it uses more tokens.

Check quality model - Select the AI model used for quality checks (e.g. "GPT-4.1 Mini"). It is recommended to use AI models that support structured output for quality checks, as the quality assessment functionality may not work properly without structured output support.

section.title: Retry Models
section.p: If translation or quality checks fail, the system retries the operation by using the next model in the list. You can select up to three fallback models in this order:

ul.li: 1st retry - The first fallback model to use (e.g. "GPT-4.1 Mini").
2nd retry - The second fallback model to use (e.g. "GPT-4.1").
3rd retry - The third fallback model to use (e.g. "GPT-5").

body.p: Click OK to save the configuration or Cancel to discard your changes.
